help.intro: Stitchwright is an editor for knitting charts. You draw stitches, colours and multi-stitch symbols; the app stores everything as open JSON and exports SVG or PNG.
help.mouse: Mouse: click and drag to paint, right-click to erase, wheel to scroll, Ctrl + wheel to zoom. Pan with the hand tool or the middle mouse button.
help.keyboard: Keyboard: arrow keys move the cursor, Space or Enter paints, Delete erases. The full list is below.
help.touch: Touch: one finger paints, two fingers zoom and pan.
help.rows: Wrong-side rows: “Right-side rows only” hides even rows and numbers 1, 3, 5 … Switch to “All rows” to draw a wrong-side row.
help.colors: Colours: pick a colour and paint. “No colour” removes the fill. Symbols stay readable on coloured cells.
help.export: Export: SVG is vector-based and best for printing. PNG is for quick sharing. The browser can print the SVG as PDF.
help.privacy: Privacy: no cloud, no accounts, no telemetry. Everything stays on this device.
help.ai: Transparency: the code was written by an AI agent and reviewed by a human. Mistakes are possible.
